Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the tidy recap. Confirming a few details from our side: 

- Stakeholder confirmations: Jason Lee (CFO) is the economic buyer and will sign off on budget/financials; Emily Park will do legal review; Procurement Ops (procurement@helixbank.com) will handle onboarding and PO issuance. Matt Chen (cc’d) is our engineering lead for the integration.
- Procurement process: We do require the vendor onboarding packet + W9 + SOC 2 Type II report (latest) before Procurement issues a vendor ID and PO. Standard terms are Net 30.

- Complete Helix vendor onboarding form (see portal link below) and attach W9, current insurance certificate, and bank wiring instructions.
- Please provide the signed quote/statement of work (we accept DocuSign).

Please upload materials to the portal and let us know when complete.
